public_upstream.fix_subject: avfilter/vf_swaprect: size the temp row buffer for the widest plane (Fixes: out of array access; repro 7aj_swaprect_odd17_nv12.nut)

oh_source.l4_evidence: vf_swaprect.c:223 allocates the temp row buffer as av_malloc_array(inlink->w, pixsteps[0]) — plane 0's step only; upstream fix sizes it across all planes (width<<shift * pixstep max, with INT_MAX check). Applies clean

vulnerability.summary: Row-swap temp buffer is sized for plane 0 only; formats where another plane's width*pixstep exceeds it (e.g. NV12 with odd widths, per the upstream repro) overrun the buffer during row exchange.
vulnerability.verification_level: source-level confirmed; family equivalence to runtime-verified CVE-2026-66036/66041; runtime repro path documented (nv12 odd-width input per upstream sample name)

满足"非首平面宽度×步长超过首平面"条件的格式与尺寸组合（NV12
奇宽为代表）。攻击者构造相应媒体流驱动行交换越界写；应用自动
处理不可信输入时无需用户交互。越界写内容为像素数据。
